slides.title: Graceful Degradation & Circuit Breakers
slides.prompt: Why are circuit breaker patterns integrated into enterprise microservice architectures?
options: To prevent cascading system failures by failing fast when downstream services become unresponsive
To encrypt database passwords in configuration files
To speed up static file caching in web browsers
To automatically increase server CPU allocations
slides.correctAnswer: To prevent cascading system failures by failing fast when downstream services become unresponsive

slides.title: Zero-Downtime Blue/Green Deployments
slides.prompt: How do Blue/Green deployment strategies eliminate downtime during production application updates?
options: By running two identical environments and switching router traffic to the updated green version after validation
By restarting database cluster nodes simultaneously
By compiling Python code directly on production web servers
By backing up user sessions to local text files
slides.correctAnswer: By running two identical environments and switching router traffic to the updated green version after validation

slides.title: 12-Factor App Configuration
slides.prompt: According to Twelve-Factor App methodology, where should application deployment configurations be stored?
options: Strictly in environment variables, completely separated from application code
Hardcoded inside core Python source files
